title: 安全網頁應用程式防護
summary: 以應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 應用資產：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Application assets: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「應用資產」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For application assets, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「應用資產」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：先界定資料與動作，才可驗證保護要求。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「信任邊界」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around application assets, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Define data/actions before verifying protection requirements. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat trust boundaries as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定規則，只改正常輸入的格式變體。 比較「應用資產」與「信任邊界」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix rules and vary benign input formatting. Compare whether evidence for application assets and trust boundaries supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「應用資產」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for application assets. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每秒 2000 請求，每請求純檢查消耗平均 0.4 ms CPU 時間（不是含等待的經過時間），需求為 0.8 CPU-s/s；單核心理想利用率 80%，未計 TLS、排隊與多執行緒額外成本。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2000 requests/s and 0.4 ms CPU time per inspection, not elapsed time including waits: demand is 0.8 CPU-s/s, an ideal 80% single-core load before TLS, queues and additional threading costs.

steps.objective: 針對「回滾決策」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For rollback decisions, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「回滾需列明安全代價及恢復條件。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「防護驗收」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Rollback decisions specify security cost and restoration conditions. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from protection acceptance to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 比較「回滾決策」與「防護驗收」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Compare whether evidence for rollback decisions and protection acceptance supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「回滾決策」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for rollback decisions. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 回滾需列明安全代價及恢復條件。
knowledge.textEn: Rollback decisions specify security cost and restoration conditions.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「防護驗收」：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「回滾決策」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring protection acceptance: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove rollback decisions passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

quiz.question: 針對「回滾決策」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of rollback decisions?
options: 部署 WAF 後就不需應用端授權。
只檢查「防護驗收」，便可取代「回滾決策」的專屬驗證。
回滾需列明安全代價及恢復條件。
optionsEn: A WAF removes the need for application authorization.
Checking protection acceptance alone replaces verification specific to rollback decisions.
Rollback decisions specify security cost and restoration conditions.
quiz.explanation: 回滾需列明安全代價及恢復條件。 相鄰的「防護驗收」有不同責任：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Rollback decisions specify security cost and restoration conditions. Neighboring protection acceptance has a different role: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 防護驗收：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Protection acceptance: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「防護驗收」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For protection acceptance, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「防護驗收」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：正常、邊界與合成異常案例均需覆蓋。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「應用資產」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around protection acceptance, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Acceptance covers benign, boundary and synthetic anomaly cases. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat application assets as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 模擬規則更新後可審查的回滾。 比較「防護驗收」與「應用資產」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Model reviewable rollback after a rule update. Compare whether evidence for protection acceptance and application assets supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 增加拒絕率必然代表安全性提高。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Higher rejection rates necessarily mean greater security. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「防護驗收」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for protection acceptance. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每秒 2000 請求，每請求純檢查消耗平均 0.4 ms CPU 時間（不是含等待的經過時間），需求為 0.8 CPU-s/s；單核心理想利用率 80%，未計 TLS、排隊與多執行緒額外成本。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 2000 requests/s and 0.4 ms CPU time per inspection, not elapsed time including waits: demand is 0.8 CPU-s/s, an ideal 80% single-core load before TLS, queues and additional threading costs.

scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

workedExample.title: 原創假想量化例與限制
workedExample.titleEn: Original hypothetical quantitative case and limits
workedExample.text: 假想每秒 2000 請求，每請求純檢查消耗平均 0.4 ms CPU 時間（不是含等待的經過時間），需求為 0.8 CPU-s/s；單核心理想利用率 80%，未計 TLS、排隊與多執行緒額外成本。

workedExample.assumptions: 只採算例中明列的教學條件；效能與安全估計須依拓撲、分布、開銷、版本與不確定度重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use only the stated teaching assumptions; recalculate for topology, distribution, overhead, versions and uncertainty.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者自行設定的教學數值；官方來源支援原理與尺寸規格，未聲稱量測此假想平台。
